correctness.rationale: Reconstructed continuous-time Markov chain +/0/- with run termination alpha, rest departure beta, freshly biased direction w=2p-1, and stable Ornstein–Uhlenbeck filter. Its stationary distribution and joint generator recurrence (nI-Q^T)m_n=nV m_(n-1) give M1,M2,M3 without moment closure. Independently computed SymPy inverse systems and simplified central third moment exactly to the stated P(a,b,w) numerator divided by positive denominator. Independent Brownian Gaussian contributes zero third cumulant. For fixed a>0 and w in (0,1), P decreases strictly on (0,a) from positive to negative and stays negative for b>=a; unique root b*(a,w)<a increases strictly in w and approaches a as w->1. w=0 symmetric exceptional case and w=1 endpoint separated. Finite numerical tests do not establish the all-parameter sign proof.
